description.value: Île Sauvage — French for 'Wild Island' — is a Victoria craft brewery specialising exclusively in Belgian-style wild ales and sour beers, using Kveik, Lactobacillus, and Brettanomyces fermentations alongside oak-ageing vessels and local fruit refermentations. The name pays dual homage to the wilderness of Vancouver Island and the wild-fermentation philosophy at the heart of every batch. Cyclists passing through Victoria's inner harbour area can stop at the Bridge Street tasting room for on-site pours or pick up canned releases to take on the road.
